data.name: Akil
data.gender_notes: Akil is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'akos', meaning 'help' or 'healer'. The name Akil signifies strength, power, and courage. In the biblical context, Akil can be linked to the ancient warrior-king David, who was known for his unwavering faith and bravery. The name Akil carries the meaning “Strong, Warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Akil usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of inner strength and divine guidance.
data.etymology: Akil belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Akil total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_latin.name: Achil
